study.name: Retest: Phase 2c: H8 Library Composition — Track 1 (brief-text-image)
study.description:
Tests 5 library compositions to determine optimal example set.
Uses optimal M/E from Phase 2a (brief-text-image, F1=0.4617) and
optimal temperature from Phase 2b (T=0.0, F1=0.5574).
Results inform library used in subsequent phases (2d-2e).
Scale-16 and Scale-32 deferred per E11 (HP pool exhausted at 4).

Dual-track context: Phase 2a found text-only brief-text (F1=0.5425)
outperformed all image-using conditions, but no pairwise differences
survived FDR correction. Both M/E levels are carried forward
independently. See Decision 16, Erratum E27.
study.retest_notes: H8 library composition Track 1 (image-using). All at T=0.0.
